headline: Court orders Bank of Irad opinion on Tulparcoin; Tulpar name case waits until 2027
dek: The Talas District Court adjourned the trademark claim against the Liberty Forum after the 12 October refusal of an injunction stood.
paragraphs: The Talas District Court on Monday ordered an expert opinion from the Bank of Irad on whether the Tulparcoin token is a financial service, and adjourned the trademark case over the Tulpar name to early 2027. No date has been fixed, and the court record shows no ruling on the claim itself.

Judge Asel Mamytbekova made the order at the 16 November hearing in the claim brought by Talas Commercial Development Group (TCDG), owner of Tulpar Talas FC, against the Liberty Forum, which issued the coin. TCDG filed on 30 September. Its trademark covers financial services, and it says the coin's use of the Tulpar name infringes it. The Forum says a token is not a financial service.
A narrow interim order limited to the logo was discussed at the hearing, but the record shows none was made. The injunction refused on 12 October stands.
Vadim Sorokin appeared for the company and Kanykei Imanbekova for the Forum. Mr Sorokin's office had not replied to a request for comment by deadline.
Tulparcoin traded at about 3.6 US cents (0.303 som at the official rate) on 16 November, according to the offshore quote. The Bank of Irad has already said the coin is not legal tender.
The court gave the bank no deadline in the record. The bank's opinion will decide whether the case goes forward as a financial-services dispute.
